turns.question: What was the order cancellation rate in August 2026, as cancelled amount divided by total order amount, not the average of daily cancellation rates?
turns.answer: The semantic layer's one cancellation rate is the share of orders cancelled (by order count, not by amount): 8.33 % for 1 to 31 August 2026; it has no amount-weighted cancellation metric, so I cannot give a cancelled-amount-over-total-amount figure, though it is computed over the whole month, not as an average of daily rates. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
